summary: Iteration 3 fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 52/52 pytest passed (12 new tests in test_iteration3.py). Verified (a) POST /api/transactions increments product.total_sold by qty and stores transaction.total_hpp = hpp*qty (Le Minerale sale: total_sold 3→5, stock_filled decremented, total_hpp populated); (b) GET /api/finance/report for daily/monthly/yearly returns all required keys (label, income{cash,transfer,qris,deposit,piutang}, income_total, hpp_total, expenses[], expenses_total, net_profit, outstanding_total, trend) with trend lengths 7/12/5; (c) net_profit = income_total - hpp_total - expenses_total (formula-validated); (d) POST /api/finance/expense (owner) accepts all 7 categories (bbm, gaji, listrik, maintenance_filter, penyusutan, sewa, lainnya), increments expenses_total, and cashier/driver receive 403; (e) pembelian_supplier cash-out from PO receive is EXCLUDED from operational expenses (verified by receiving PO and confirming expenses_total unchanged). Frontend (mobile 390x844): Owner login OK, Dashboard 'Laporan Keuangan' quick action navigates to /reports; period chips (period-daily/monthly/yearly) switch data live; hero renders 'Laba Bersih Operasional Rp610.088', metric cards (Total Omset, Total HPP, Beban Operasional, Piutang Belum Lunas) all render with correct values, income breakdown (Tunai/Transfer/QRIS/Deposit/Pelunasan Piutang) displays, bar trend chart renders with Omset+Laba legend, expenses list shows all 7 categories, 'Catat Beban' modal opens with 7 exp-cat chips + exp-amount + exp-desc + save-expense (save posts and refreshes list), export-pdf/export-csv buttons present and don't crash on web. FIX 1 real-time verified: after cash checkout of 1x Air Isi Ulang RO 19L, product card updated immediately WITHOUT refresh: Tersisa 169→168, Terjual 3→4. FIX 2 label format verified: refill product shows 'Tersisa: n | Terjual: n' (NO Wadah Kosong), LPG and galon_brand show 'Tersisa: n | Terjual: n | Wadah Kosong: n', color green when stock_filled>reorder_point (all in-stock products verified green).
